cards.title: Sector Uprisings
cards.effect: All factions lose 1 influence in a controlled system.

cards.title: Final Conflagration
cards.effect: Game ends immediately when tension maxes.

cards.title: Cascade Refugees
cards.effect: Each faction gains 1 fleet but loses 1 Credit.

cards.title: Rift Expansion
cards.effect: Reveal one hex in each row.

cards.title: Galaxy in Flames
cards.effect: Score immediate Victory Points for controlled systems.

cards.title: Blackout Protocol
cards.effect: Hands reduced by 1 until round end.

cards.title: Emergency Conclave
cards.effect: First player gains 1 gold bonus token.

cards.title: Last Broadcast
cards.effect: Endgame triggered when tension hits max.
